title: Machine Ko Haath Dena
segs: Chapter 20. Machine Ko Haath Dena.

Ek 12 digits ka order number team ke kaam mein baar-baar laut aata tha. Woh sorting test mein aaya. 4 order numbers ko Aadhaar number bata diya gaya, aur guard unhe chhupa deta. Woh edge cases ki list mein phir aaya (edge case matlab anokhe, kam hone wale mamle). Farah ke agents ko apna kaam karne ke liye order numbers dekhne the. Customers unhe hamesha type karte the.

Dikkat seedhi thi. Aankh ko order number aur Aadhaar number ek jaise dikhte hain. Jo rule sirf shape dekhta hai, woh bhi unhe alag nahi kar sakta. Dono 12 digits ke hain, kabhi 4-4 ke groups mein. Digits mein kuch nahi batata ki kaun sa kaun hai.

Ek rule bina kharch ke dayra chhota karta hai. Asli Aadhaar number 0 ya 1 se shuru nahi hota. Uska aakhri digit ek check digit hota hai. Woh baaki 11 digits se ek tay hisaab se nikalta hai, jise Verhoeff scheme kehte hain. Pattern checker woh hisaab pehle chala sakta hai. Woh lagbhag 10 mein se 9 look-alikes hata deta hai, order numbers samet. Jo bachta hai woh 10 mein se ek hai jo ittefaq se paas ho gaya.

Ek Tuesday ko Imran Qureshi ne kaha ki jo numbers paas hue, unke baare mein jaanne ka ek hi tareeka hai. Order system se poochho. Is chapter mein aap dekhte hain ki model ko yeh karne ki ijaazat kaise milti hai, uska kharch kya hai, aur use kahan rokna hai.
Case: ek number jo do cheezon mein se ek hai.

Ab tak model ek hi tarah ka kaam karta tha. Woh text padhta tha aur text likhta tha. Phir koi insaan ya program use padhta tha. Imran kuch alag chahta tha. Woh chahta tha ki model keh sake, "Mujhe pakka nahi ki yeh number kya hai." Phir woh orders table mein look-up maange. Table saved rows ka grid hota hai, register jaisa.
Ek model jo maang sakta hai.

Yeh hai asli baat. Model kuch chala nahi sakta. Woh sirf maang sakta hai. Ek aise saathi ko sochiye jiske paas system ka access nahi. Woh aapko parchi bhejta hai: "Please order 4521 check kar do." Aap check chalate hain aur jawaab wapas bhejte hain. Model bhi aise hi kaam karta hai. Imran ne ise card par 5 steps mein likha.

Request model ko batati hai ki kaun se functions maujood hain. Function ek naam wali recipe hai. Har ek ka naam, kaam, aur woh cheezein hoti hain jo woh leta hai. In cheezon ko arguments kehte hain. Description bas aur text hai. Agar model ko koi function chahiye, toh woh prose ki jagah ek request se jawaab deta hai. Woh kehta hai: yeh function in arguments ke saath chalao. Function program chalata hai. Model nahi. Program result ko ek aur message ki tarah wapas bhejta hai. Model ya toh ek aur call maangta hai, ya apna aakhri jawaab likhta hai. Loop tab tak chalta hai jab tak model ruk na jaaye ya program use rok na de. Loop ek hi step ko baar-baar karna hai.
Paribhasha: Tool calling.

Model program se ek function chalane ko kehta hai. Woh function ka naam aur arguments batata hai. Program use chalata hai aur result wapas bhejta hai. Yeh dukaandaar se stock check karwane jaisa hai. Yahi trick har "AI action leta hai" ke peeche hai. Kuch dhoondhna, slot book karna aur record update karna, sab aise hi hota hai. Neeche sirf text aata-jaata hai. Beech ka aam code kaam karta hai.

Ab hisson ko jodiye. Ek model, functions ka ek set jo woh maang sakta hai, ek loop, aur kab rukna hai uska rule, milkar ek AI agent banate hain. Errands ki list aur curfew wale ek madadgaar ko sochiye. Sahaj mein yeh word pehle se kuch matlab rakhta tha, kyunki Farah ka staff support agents tha. Anaya ne turant faisla kar diya. Unke support agents the. Machine ke AI agents the.
Label par likhe shabd.

Imran ne pehla function khud likha. Woh ek number leta tha. Woh batata tha ki us number ka order hai ya nahi, aur woh kis customer ka hai. Usne use ek line ka description diya aur chalaya. Model ne galat function maanga.

Toolbox mein 2 functions the. Ek order dhoondhta tha. Ek payment dhoondhta tha. Pehle ke description mein poora yahi likha tha, "Looks up information about a customer's number." Model ne ise ek seedha sentence padha. Usne doosra function chun liya.

"Woh label padhta hai," Imran ne kaha. "Chunne ka bas yahi tareeka hai." Dukaan ki shelf ke labels sochiye. Label dhundhla ho, toh model galat dabba utha leta hai. Yeh likhne ki galti hai. Yeh samajh ki kami nahi hai.

Table 20.1: Ek vague aur ek achha tool description. Vague. Description: Looks up information about a customer's number. Good. Description: Returns whether an order exists with this exact number, and the customer it belongs to. Does not return payment history, amounts or addresses. For payments, use look_up_payment instead.

Achha tool description batata hai ki function kya wapas deta hai. Woh batata hai ki kya wapas nahi deta. Woh batata hai ki kab doosra function use karna hai. Label mein milte-julte function ka naam likhne se confusion ruk jaata hai. Zyadatar teams yeh confusion launch ke baad dekhti hain. Imran ne ise system ki sabse kam sarahi gayi code ki line kaha. Tool description English mein likha hua code hai.
Har round pichhle se mehnga.

Loop chal gaya. Ek message aaya jisme 12 digits ka number tha. Finder ne kaha ki yeh Aadhaar number ho sakta hai ya order number. Model ne look-up maanga, aur program ne chalaya. Jawaab aaya: us number ka ek order hai. Model ne tay kiya ki yeh order number hai. Guard ne use chhod diya.

Phir Anaya ne poochha ki iska kharch kya hai. Ek call lagbhag 1,200 tokens ki hai, Imran ne kaha. Token text ki ek Lego eent hai, aur aap har eent ke paise dete hain. Lekin yeh ek se zyada call thi. Loop ke har chakkar mein ab tak ki poori baatcheet dobara bheji jaati hai. Tool ka jawaab sabse aakhir mein jud jaata hai. Yeh us SMS jaisa hai jo har baar dobara bhejne par lamba hota jaata hai.

Table 20.2: 6 steps ke loop mein bheje gaye tokens. 1. Bheje gaye tokens: 1,200. 2. Bheje gaye tokens: 1,500. 3. Bheje gaye tokens: 1,800. 4. Bheje gaye tokens: 2,100. 5. Bheje gaye tokens: 2,400. 6. Bheje gaye tokens: 2,700. Total. Bheje gaye tokens: 11,700.

6 steps ka kharch ek call se lagbhag 10 guna tha. Yeh figures Imran ke hain, is example ke liye. Aam rule zyada zaroori hai. Input steps ki ginti se tez badhta hai. Har step apne se pehle ke saare steps saath leke chalta hai.
Toh jo agent plan se 2 steps zyada leta hai, woh bill ko double kar sakta hai. Kitne steps ki ijaazat dena hai, yeh ek faisla hai. Uski ek keemat hai.
Chaar bure din.
Agli dopahar Imran ne jaan-boojh kar loop ko 4 tareekon se tod diya. Woh dikhana chahta tha ki aisi machine galat hone par kya karti hai.

Table 20.3: Loop ke fail hone ke 4 tareeke. Order system dheema tha aur look-up time out ho gaya. Model ne kya kiya: Usne dobara try kiya, aur phir dobara. 14wi try tak woh wahi look-up maang raha tha, badhte kharch par. Function ne ek error message wapas diya. Model ne kya kiya: Usne error ko result ki tarah padha, aur usse ek pakke yakeen wala sentence likh diya. Model ne aisa function bulaya jo tha hi nahi. Model ne kya kiya: Usne function gadh liya, sahi lagne wale arguments ke saath. 2 functions ne ek doosre ka kaam ulta kar diya. Model ne kya kiya: Woh unke beech bina ant ke aata-jaata raha.

"Inmein se har ek control ki problem hai," Imran ne kaha. Model kam kaabil nahi hua tha. Use galat hone ke anginat mauke mil gaye the. Bina curfew ke errands par bheje gaye madadgaar ko sochiye. Usne ek file kholi aur sabse upar ek line jodi: zyada se zyada 5 rounds. Uske baad ruko aur kaho ki faisla nahi kar paaye.
Mukhya vichaar: Loop mein sabse pehle kya likhna hai.

Woh line step limit hai. Yeh curfew hai. Model ise tay nahi karta, aur us par bharosa nahi kiya ja sakta. Isliye program ko karna hoga. Teams ise aapki soch se zyada baar bhool jaati hain. Bina rukne ke rule wala loop agent nahi hai. Woh khula chhoda hua nal hai, jisse paani bahta rehta hai.
Padhna aur karna.

Hafte ke aakhir mein Farah ne ek sujhaav diya. Agar model order dhoondh sakta hai, toh kya woh customer ko message bhi bhej sakta hai? Guard jab koi number chhupaye, toh woh turant keh sakta hai, "Please yahan apna Aadhaar share na karein."
Anaya ko is idea ka khinchaav mehsoos hua. Jo customer identity number type karta hai, use narmi se bataya jaana chahiye ki iski zaroorat nahi.
Imran ne sir hilaya. Woh idea ke khilaaf nahi tha. Woh uske kehne ke tareeke ke khilaaf tha. Functions 2 tarah ke hote hain, usne kaha.

Jo functions padhte hain, unse ubra ja sakta hai. Zyada se zyada, machine ko bure jaankari milti hai aur team dobara try karti hai. Jo functions karte hain, unhe kabhi wapas nahi liya ja sakta. Message bhejna, bill bharna, row delete karna aur slot book karna, sab karte hain. Message chala gaya. Customer ne dekh liya. Yeh chitthi padhne aur chitthi daalne ke fark jaisa hai.

Table 20.4: Padhne wale functions aur karne wale functions. Examples. Padhte hain: Order dhoondhna; table padhna. Karte hain: Message bhejna; bill bharna; row delete karna. Galat hua toh. Padhte hain: Model ko galat jaankari milti hai, aur aap dobara try karte hain. Karte hain: Action ho chuka hota hai aur wapas nahi ho sakta. Control. Padhte hain: Chalne dijiye, step limit ke andar. Karte hain: Har ek ko ek insaan approve karta hai, ya action itna chhota aur fixed hai ki galat ho hi nahi sakta.

Model message bhej sakta hai ya nahi, yeh product ka faisla hai. Asli sawaal yeh hai ki loop mein insaan kahan khada hai. Team ne ise jaldi tay kar liya, kyunki doosra vikalp unke paas tha. Guard customers ko kuch likhega hi nahi. Uski jagah Farah pehle se ek chhota fixed notice likhegi, teeno bhashaon mein. Lakshmi use approve karengi. Jab bhi koi number chhupaya jaayega, woh dikhega.
Toh machine tay karti hai ki notice kab dikhana hai. Insaan tay karte hain ki usme kya likha hai. Anaya ko yeh us design se kaafi behtar laga jo usne maanga tha.
Chapter ka saaransh.

Model kuch chala nahi sakta. Woh sirf maang sakta hai. Tool calling mein program model ko batata hai ki kaun se functions maujood hain. Model ek ko chalane ki request se jawaab deta hai. Program use chalata hai aur result wapas bhejta hai. Yeh tab tak dohrata hai jab tak model aakhri jawaab na likh de ya koi use rok na de.

Model function ko uska description padhkar chunta hai. Dhundhla description ek bug hai. Aisa loop ek AI agent hai. Har round pichhla sab kuch saath bhejta hai. Isliye kharch steps ki ginti se tez badhta hai. Zyadatar agent failures control ki failures hain, samajh ki nahi. Isliye program ka tay kiya step limit sabse pehle likhna hai. Jo functions sirf padhte hain, unhe chalne diya ja sakta hai. Jo functions karte hain, unhe wapas nahi kiya ja sakta. Wahan ek insaan, ya pehle se likha fixed message, hona chahiye.
Agle chapter mein ek vendor ki slide kehti hai ki poori library har sawaal ke saath ja sakti hai. Anaya us daave ko parakhti hai. Vendor woh company hai jo aapko product bechti hai.
